sources.reason: Authoritative repository terminology for Work Item closure and evidence.

riskAssessment.reason: The exact remote branches are unmerged and eleven historical worktrees are dirty, but the user explicitly directed a pre-publication state with only synchronized main remaining; inventory and postconditions must be recorded before removal.

executionDecision.reason: The user authorized the exact final convergence target; execute only after recording the target inventory and proving every postcondition.

preReviewWarnings: Verify each destructive target against the recorded inventory; do not delete semantic tags or the active cleanup worktree before lifecycle closure.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: The Summary records every exact remote and local branch/worktree target, its pre-removal SHA or dirty-state evidence, and the user authorization basis.
All remote branches other than origin/main are removed after their exact names are recorded; semantic-version tags remain untouched.

All historical local worktrees and local branches other than the synchronized main base and the active cleanup Work Item are removed only after inventory capture; active cleanup lifecycle removal occurs through ai-close-work-item.
After closure and final pruning, git worktree list contains only the synchronized main worktree and git branch -r contains only origin/main and origin/HEAD.
Focused governance checks and aggregate PR/hosted CI evidence pass without a full local quality rerun under the temporary authorized efficiency policy.
guidelines: Treat every destructive Git target as an exact, pre-inventoried path or ref; do not use broad glob deletes.
Preserve semantic-version tags and provider release artifacts.
Record pre-state and post-state evidence in the Summary before archiving.
Use focused verification under the user-authorized temporary efficiency agreement; do not weaken hosted PR checks.

intent.problem: The repository retains seven unmerged remote historical branches, many stale local branches, and dozens of historical worktrees, including eleven with uncommitted changes. This conflicts with the user's required pre-publication state: remote only main and local only the remote-synchronized main.
constraints: Delete only recorded exact refs and worktree paths; do not use broad recursive deletion.
Do not delete semantic-version tags, provider Releases, or current main.
Do not remove the active cleanup worktree before its PR, merge, and ai-close-work-item lifecycle completes.
Use focused local checks; full local quality is explicitly optional for this non-release cleanup Work Item.
intent.rationale: A single audited convergence Work Item makes the destructive final cleanup reviewable and leaves publication with one unambiguous, synchronized base identity.

approvalEvidence.reason: Explicit authorization covers removal of all remote branches other than main and all local worktrees/branches other than remote-synchronized main before publication.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: The user explicitly required that before publication remote retain only main and local retain only remote-synchronized main.

rollbackNote: No deleted historical branch/worktree is recreated automatically. The Summary records pre-removal SHA and path evidence so a human can deliberately recover from Git object retention or a separate authorized restoration procedure.
rawUserRequest: 最后发版本之前，将远端、本地的分支都整理干净。远端只有 main，本地也只有远端同步一致的 main。需要的时候，自己查看 Actions 结果，目标计划全部完成前不要停止。
